candidate.reconstruction: bash replay_e16.sh PYTHON ABS_OUTDIR (replays candidate05 byte-for-byte, then r1..t2; compare_replay.py must exit 0 for both boards)

phases.pass: compare_replay.py --board KA and --board KB exit 0; candidate hashes above equal

phases.command: write the t2 access delta (segments and vias) into fresh copies of the candidate05 KA/KB .kicad_pcb, never into boards/**
phases.pass: fresh-copy hashes recorded; canonical boards/** and placements.lock.json byte-identical before/after
phases.status: NOT IMPLEMENTED: no reviewed materializer exists yet; it is source work required before any admission request

phases.command: scripts/kicad/run.sh pcb ... zone fill on each fresh copy (KiCad 10.0.6, pinned image)
scripts/kicad/run.sh pcb drc --severity-all --format json on each filled copy
phases.pass: full warning and error list retained (no severity filter); every violation classified, none silently waived

phases.command: native unconnected-item report for +12V/-12V/+5V/AGND on each filled copy
phases.pass: native open-edge census reconciled pad-by-pad against K?-t2-port-obligations.json; differences reported, not forced

checks.preservation: boards/**, design/grid/placements.lock.json and decision.json SHA-256 equal before and after
checks.fresh_copy: every native phase works on a fresh copy made from the reconstructed candidate; inputs re-hashed after each phase

resources.workers: at most two native workers globally, reserved by the parent admission
resources.per_worker: 6 GiB no-swap systemd slice, 12 GiB aggregate, >=8 GiB MemAvailable at launch (native_resource_guard.py)
resources.deadlines: Python phase 28 min, board phase 43 min (ci_native_admission.py)
resources.cleanup: watchdog removes only containers with this worker label, verifies no survivors, then exits; worker identity single-use

binding_fields_unfilled.note: Only a parent admission of the actual GitHub run may fill these; old tokens/receipts are not reusable. This source continuation neither mints nor dispatches.
